# Alpha 多样性分析

- 构建 microtable 对象
- 抽平处理
- 计算 Alpha 多样性指标
- 按分组进行比较和可视化

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: alpha-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(patchwork)
library(jsonlite)
source("figure-notes.R")
```

## 构建 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: alpha-create-microtable
# 读取保存的 CSV 文件
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
```

## 序列量统计与抽平

```{r}
#| label: alpha-check-sample-sums
# 检查各样本的序列量，确定抽平深度
mt$sample_sums() |> summary()
```

```{r}
#| label: rarefy
mt_rarefied = mt$clone(deep = TRUE)
mt_rarefied$rarefy_samples(sample.size = max(min(mt$sample_sums(), 20000)))
mt_rarefied$tidy_dataset()
```

```{r}
#| label: check-rarefied
mt_rarefied$sample_sums() |> summary()
```

## Alpha 多样性指标计算

```{r}
#| label: calc-alpha
measures = c("Observed", "Chao1", "Shannon", "Simpson")
mt$cal_alphadiv(measures = measures)

plot_alpha_box = function(dataset, group_var) {
    dataset$alpha_diversity |>
        as.data.frame() |>
        rownames_to_column("sample") |>
        left_join(
            dataset$sample_table |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column("sample"),
            by = "sample"
        ) |>
        pivot_longer(all_of(measures), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
        ggplot(aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = value, fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.18, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.75) +
        facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Alpha diversity") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

## 按分组类型比较

### 按品种比较

```{r}
#| label: fig-alpha-by-breed
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: "按品种（Duroc/Landrace/Yorkshire）的 Alpha 多样性比较。"
mt$sample_table$breed <- factor(mt$sample_table$breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire"))
t2 = trans_alpha$new(dataset = mt, group = "breed")
t2$cal_diff(method = "KW")

plot_alpha_box(mt, "breed")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-alpha-by-breed
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("alpha-by-breed")
```

### 按基因型比较

```{r}
#| label: fig-alpha-by-genotype
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: "按基因型（AA/GA/GG）的 Alpha 多样性比较。"
mt$sample_table$genotype <- factor(mt$sample_table$genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
t3 = trans_alpha$new(dataset = mt, group = "genotype")
t3$cal_diff(method = "KW")

plot_alpha_box(mt, "genotype")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-alpha-by-genotype
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("alpha-by-genotype")
```
